_note: Authored 2026-09-19 with the daytime tree. Answers trace to site.json configurations and the included list, the jazz duo's setlist and repertoire.json's decades, the unamplified line on the ceremony page, and the first-learned-song line on the solo guitarist page. The music therapy answer is a plain no: a board-certified music therapist is a different, clinical booking, and nothing clinical is claimed for a performance. Questions are worded the way activity directors search.

service.name: Live music for senior living and memory care
service.serviceType: Live music entertainment for assisted living, memory care and independent living communities and senior centers
service.description: A jazz duo, upright bass and guitar, or a solo musician for the afternoon program at assisted living, memory care and independent living communities and senior centers across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor: the standards and the Great American Songbook at 65 to 72 dBA, no stage, for one date or a standing weekday afternoon, with a certificate of insurance, a W-9 and one itemised invoice in the quote.

faqs.q: Do you play at assisted living and memory care communities?
faqs.a: Yes. A solo musician or a duo plays the common area, the dining hall or the activity space of an assisted living, memory care or independent living community, and senior centers too, usually on a weekday afternoon. Signet Artists books them across Denver and the Front Range.

No. It's a live performance for the residents, and a board-certified music therapist is a different booking with a clinical purpose. What we bring is musicians playing the songs the residents know, in the common area with no stage.

faqs.q: Can we book a standing monthly date?
faqs.a: Yes. The same weekday afternoon each month or every other week runs on one contract with one personal contact for the whole run, and the set changes from visit to visit, so the residents hear new songs beside the ones they ask for again.

faqs.q: How long is a visit, and what does the space need?
faqs.a: One set of 45 to 60 minutes, or two shorter sets with a break. A duo sets up in about 8 by 6 feet and a solo in 6 by 4, on the floor, with one outlet. Setup is 45 minutes to an hour before the program, packing up takes half an hour, and the musicians use whichever door the community prefers.

faqs.q: Do you provide a certificate of insurance and a W-9?
faqs.a: Yes. A certificate of insurance naming the community as additional insured, a W-9 and one itemized invoice that matches your purchase order come in the same email as the contract, so the business office can set up the vendor before the first visit.
